hook: Model proofs, open Siri, a 90% AI cost cut and India's models
summary: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open-source way to prove which weights produced a reply, and Apple opened Siri AI to all developers.
Revolut says self-hosted GLM models cut its AI coding inference bill by about 90% while speeding up its engineers.
Google lets schools disable Gemini but not AI in Search, and the IndiaAI Mission launched three indigenous foundation models.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses
stories.summary: Anthropic unveiled FlashProve, an open‑source prototype that generates cryptographic proofs showing a language‑model reply came from a specific set of weights. The system runs at about 110 tokens per second on Meta’s Llama 4 Maverick, with proofs around 19 MB that a CPU can check in 17‑21 seconds.
stories.why_it_matters: It gives AI users a way to confirm the model that generated a response, addressing concerns about hidden model swapping in AI services.
source_titles: Anthropic releases FlashProve, open-source code that cryptographically verifies an AI response came from a given model, not a cheaper one swapped in by a router (Anthropic)
Anthropic Releases FlashProve for Cryptographic AI Inference Proofs
Anthropic Unveils FlashProve for Proving Which Model Answered You
stories.line: Anthropic's FlashProve offers cryptographic proof of the model used
stories.detail: Prototype runs ~110 tokens/s on Llama 4 Maverick; 19 MB proofs check on a CPU in 17-21s

stories.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta
stories.summary: Apple announced that developers can integrate Siri AI into any iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS app using App Intents, starting with the iOS 27.3 beta. The preview lets apps expose content and actions for natural‑language requests without naming the app.
stories.why_it_matters: It expands Siri AI’s reach, letting third‑party apps perform tasks via voice, which could increase user engagement and drive AI adoption on Apple devices.
source_titles: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers, letting any app on iOS 27.3 beta and other 27.3 OS betas bring its content and actions into Siri AI by using App Intents (Apple Developer)

Siri AI opens to third-party apps in iOS 27.3 beta
stories.line: Apple lets every developer plug apps into Siri AI
stories.detail: Starts in the iOS 27.3 beta: apps expose actions so users needn't name the app

stories.headline: Revolut cuts AI coding inference costs by about 90% with self‑hosted GLM
stories.summary: Revolut reduced its AI coding inference spend to roughly one‑tenth of prior costs by self‑hosting open‑weight GLM models from Z.ai on its own NVIDIA GPUs. The change improved engineering lead time by 70% and coding time by 60% for about 2,000 engineers.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how large fintechs can lower AI operating expenses and speed development by moving to open‑source models.
source_titles: Revolut says it cut AI coding inference costs by ~90% in less than a year by making self-hosted GLM models its default over commercial tools like Claude Code (Tobias Mann/The Register)
Europe's Biggest Tech Startup Cuts AI Coding Costs by 90% Using Chinese Model

stories.detail: Z.ai open-weight models on its own NVIDIA GPUs; lead time 70% better for ~2,000 engineers

stories.headline: Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search
stories.summary: Google announced that K‑12 administrators can turn off Gemini, Gemini Notebook and AI features individually. However, schools that block AI will also lose access to Google Search, which now always includes AI Mode and AI Overviews.
stories.why_it_matters: The policy ties Google’s dominant search tool to its AI services, limiting schools’ ability to use Search without AI.
source_titles: Google lets schools switch off Gemini, but AI in Search is all or nothing
Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
stories.line: Gemini can now be turned off in K-12, yet Search stays AI-only
stories.detail: Blocking AI also cuts off Google Search, which now always shows AI Mode and AI Overviews

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models
stories.summary: The IndiaAI Mission released three domestically developed foundation models—EKA‑1 by Soket AI Labs and Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B by ZenteiQ AiTech Innovations—at a New Delhi event on Nov 3. EKA‑1 is a 26.3‑billion‑parameter model supporting 22 Indian languages, while the Dhīr models are open‑source multilingual assistants designed for on‑premise and offline use.
stories.why_it_matters: The models provide India with locally tailored AI capabilities and the ability to run AI securely without cloud connectivity.
